name: sacrvm-newskit
description: Zero-dependency editorial kit for publishing long-form, source-backed articles - a sister of SACRVM APPKIT. Appkit's look with condensed news headlines, article primitives, and sources/provenance as first-class citizens. No build step, no node_modules - vendor the newskit/ folder as plain files. This package exists only as a courtesy mirror of those files.
author: SACRVM
